research_question: Does a differentiable MSCL-style gray-mean consistency term improve the frozen epoch-58 GT-centered residual refiner?

attribution_rule.reason: A matched continuation control separates gray-prior benefit from extra optimization.

data.coarse_prompt: frozen SAM-Med3D fixed click-3 logits, seed 20260723

fixed_hyperparameters.augmentations: original joint flips, zero-filled shifts <=12, image scale/offset/noise
fixed_hyperparameters.segmentation_loss: original MONAI DiceCELoss: sigmoid, Dice weight 1, CE weight 1
fixed_hyperparameters.gray_loss: MSE between GT-region T1ce mean and sigmoid(logit/1.0)-weighted T1ce mean
fixed_hyperparameters.checkpoint_selection: strict maximum validation scan-macro Dice including continuation epoch 0

paper_alignment.local_choice: Use a soft predicted region so the term is differentiable.
paper_alignment.claim_policy: Call this MSCL-style local implementation, not an exact undisclosed-code reproduction.

decision_policy: Do not inspect or evaluate the 270-case test set during this experiment.
Do not change the loss weight, seed, data, augmentation, batch size, learning rate, patience, or selection metric after launch.
Report both arms even if the target is missed.
A score above 0.70 is a validation result and is not automatically a new test result.
